<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>hrkurdish | UEFN Creator and Verse Developer</title>
<meta name="description" content="Fortnite islands built in UEFN and scripted in Verse. Over 10 maps made, with lower prices than other creators.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#000000">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="site-css">
@property --ang{ syntax:'<angle>'; inherits:false; initial-value:0deg; }

/* ================= TOKENS ================= */
:root{
  --bg:#000;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  --line-2:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --text:#F5F5F7;
  --soft:#C7C7CC;
  --muted:#86868B;
  --dim:#2C2C2E;
  --blue:#0A84FF;
  --sky:#64D2FF;
  --orange:#FF6B2C;
  --yellow:#FFD60A;
  --purple:#BF5AF2;
  --green:#30D158;
  --discord:#5865F2;
  --font:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Geist", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --mono:"SF Mono", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --inout:cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1);
  color-scheme:dark;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]){ --bg:#000; } }
:root[data-theme="dark"]{ --bg:#000; }
*,*::before,*::after{ box-sizing:inherit; }
html{ background:#000; scroll-behavior:smooth; scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 60px); scrollbar-width:thin; scrollbar-color:#3A3A3C transparent; }
html.lenis, html.lenis body{ height:auto; }
.lenis.lenis-smooth{ scroll-behavior:auto !important; }
.lenis.lenis-stopped{ overflow:hidden; }
body{
  margin:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--font); font-size:17px; line-height:1.5; letter-spacing:-.011em;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale; overflow-x:hidden;
}
@supports (overflow:clip){ body{ overflow-x:clip; } }
::selection{ background:rgba(10,132,255,.4); color:#fff; }
h1,h2,h3,h4{ text-wrap:balance; }
p{ text-wrap:pretty; }
img{ max-width:100%; display:block; }
a{ color:inherit; text-decoration:none; }
button{ font:inherit; color:inherit; }
:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--sky); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:12px; }
.wrap{ width:min(1180px, 100% - 40px); margin-inline:auto; }
section{ position:relative; padding:clamp(100px, 12vw, 160px) 0; }
.mono{ font-family:var(--mono); letter-spacing:.01em; }

/* ================= LOADER ================= */
.loader{ position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:300; background:#000; display:grid; place-items:center; animation:loaderOut 1s var(--inout) 1s forwards; }
.loader-in{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:18px; animation:loaderIn .7s var(--out) both, loaderFade .45s var(--inout) 1s forwards; }
.loader-name{ font-size:clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 2.6rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.045em; }
.loader-bar{ width:min(200px, 50vw); height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.12); overflow:hidden; }
.loader-bar span{ display:block; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--purple), var(--orange)); transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(0); animation:load .85s var(--inout) .1s forwards; }
@keyframes load{ to{ transform:scaleX(1); } }
@keyframes loaderIn{ from{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px); } }
@keyframes loaderFade{ to{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(-24px); } }
@keyframes loaderOut{ to{ transform:translateY(-100%); visibility:hidden; } }

/* ================= NAV ================= */
.nav{
  position:fixed; inset:0 0 auto 0; z-index:60; padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.5); backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent; transition:background .6s var(--out), border-color .6s var(--out);
}
.nav.scrolled{ background:rgba(0,0,0,.72); border-bottom-color:var(--line); }
.nav-in{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; height:56px; }
.brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-weight:700; font-size:1.1rem; letter-spacing:-.04em; white-space:nowrap; }
.brand i{ width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--purple)); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(100,210,255,.8); }
.nav-links{ position:relative; display:flex; gap:2px; margin-left:auto; }
.nav-links a{ position:relative; z-index:1; padding:6px 13px; border-radius:980px; font-size:.84rem; color:var(--soft); white-space:nowrap; transition:color .35s var(--out); }
.nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a.active{ color:#fff; }
.nav-ind{ position:absolute; left:0; top:0; height:100%; width:0; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:transform .7s var(--out), width .7s var(--out), opacity .4s var(--out); }
.nav-ind.on{ opacity:1; }
.progress{ position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-1px; height:1.5px; transform-origin:left; transform:scaleX(0); background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--purple), var(--orange)); }

/* ================= BUTTONS ================= */
.pill{
  position:relative; overflow:hidden; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:980px; padding:13px 24px; font-size:.98rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.01em; white-space:nowrap;
  border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:background .4s var(--out), border-color .4s var(--out), box-shadow .4s var(--out), transform .4s var(--out), translate .6s var(--out);
}
.pill.sm{ padding:7px 15px; font-size:.82rem; }
.pill svg{ width:17px; height:17px; flex:none; }
.pill.primary{ background:var(--blue); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 8px 28px -10px rgba(10,132,255,.9); }
.pill.primary:hover{ background:#2891FF; box-shadow:0 12px 36px -8px rgba(10,132,255,1); }
.pill.discord{ background:var(--discord); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 8px 28px -10px rgba(88,101,242,.95); }
.pill.discord:hover{ background:#6A76F5; box-shadow:0 12px 36px -8px rgba(88,101,242,1); }
.pill.glass{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12); color:var(--text); }
.pill.glass:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22); }
.pill.primary::after, .pill.discord::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 50%, transparent 65%);
  transform:translateX(-110%); transition:transform .9s var(--out);
}
.pill.primary:hover::after, .pill.discord:hover::after{ transform:translateX(110%); }
.pill:active{ transform:scale(.97); }
.icon-btn{
  position:relative; width:40px; height:40px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  transition:background .35s var(--out), border-color .35s var(--out), transform .45s var(--out);
}
.icon-btn:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.16); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2); transform:scale(1.06); }
.icon-btn:active{ transform:scale(.94); }
.icon-btn svg{ width:16px; height:16px; }
.icon-btn.lg{ width:48px; height:48px; }
.code-btn .ic-check{ display:none; color:var(--green); }
.code-btn.copied .ic-copy{ display:none; }
.code-btn.copied .ic-check{ display:block; animation:popCheck .5s var(--out); }
@keyframes popCheck{ from{ transform:scale(.4) rotate(-25deg); opacity:0; } to{ transform:none; opacity:1; } }
.tlink{ color:var(--sky); transition:opacity .3s; }
.tlink:hover{ opacity:.7; }

/* ================= HERO ================= */
.hero{ position:relative; height:100svh; min-height:640px; display:grid; place-items:center; text-align:center; overflow:hidden; padding:0; }
.aurora{ position:absolute; inset:-10%; z-index:0; will-change:transform; pointer-events:none; }
.blob{ position:absolute; width:62vmax; height:62vmax; border-radius:50%; will-change:transform; }
.b1{ background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(10,132,255,.42) 0%, rgba(10,132,255,.12) 38%, rgba(10,132,255,0) 66%); top:-22%; left:-16%; animation:drift1 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.b2{ background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(191,90,242,.38) 0%, rgba(191,90,242,.1) 38%, rgba(191,90,242,0) 66%); top:0; right:-24%; animation:drift2 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.b3{ background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,107,44,.26) 0%, rgba(255,107,44,.07) 38%, rgba(255,107,44,0) 66%); bottom:-42%; left:14%; animation:drift3 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes drift1{ to{ transform:translate3d(16vw, 12vh, 0) scale(1.12); } }
@keyframes drift2{ to{ transform:translate3d(-18vw, 8vh, 0) scale(.94); } }
@keyframes drift3{ to{ transform:translate3d(10vw, -14vh, 0) scale(1.1); } }
.hero::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0 0; height:40%; background:linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0), #000); z-index:1; pointer-events:none; }
.hero-content{ position:relative; z-index:2; padding:90px 20px 60px; will-change:transform, opacity; }
.hero-pill{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 15px 7px 12px; border-radius:980px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); font-size:.88rem; color:var(--soft);
  opacity:0; animation:fadeUp 1.1s var(--out) 1.35s forwards;
}
.live{ width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); animation:ping 2s var(--out) infinite; }
@keyframes ping{ 0%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(48,209,88,.55); } 80%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(48,209,88,0); } }
.hero-title{ font-size:clamp(4.2rem, 16.5vw, 13rem); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.055em; line-height:.92; margin:.14em 0 .16em; }
.hero-title .ch{
  display:inline-block; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 40%, #9A9AA0 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
  opacity:0; transform:translateY(.32em); filter:blur(8px);
  animation:chIn 1.3s var(--out) forwards; animation-delay:calc(1.15s + var(--i) * 45ms);
}
@keyframes chIn{ to{ opacity:1; transform:none; filter:blur(0); } }
.hero-sub{ font-size:clamp(1.15rem, 2.4vw, 1.6rem); font-weight:500; color:var(--soft); letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1.3; max-width:30ch; margin:0 auto 34px; }
.hero-sub .w > span{ transform:translateY(105%); animation:wordIn 1.2s var(--out) forwards; animation-delay:calc(1.7s + var(--i) * 40ms); }
@keyframes wordIn{ to{ transform:none; } }
.hero-cta{ display:flex; gap:12px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; opacity:0; animation:fadeUp 1.1s var(--out) 2.1s forwards; }
@keyframes fadeUp{ from{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(20px); } to{ opacity:1; transform:none; } }

.floaty{ position:absolute; z-index:2; opacity:0; scale:.7; animation:popIn 1.1s var(--out) forwards; animation-delay:calc(2.1s + var(--i) * .1s); will-change:translate; }
.floaty span{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:9px 16px; border-radius:980px; white-space:nowrap;
  background:rgba(28,28,30,.72); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:500;
  animation:bob 7s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * -1.8s);
}
.floaty i{ width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c); }
@keyframes popIn{ to{ opacity:1; scale:1; } }
@keyframes bob{ 0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0); } 50%{ transform:translateY(-12px); } }
.scroll-cue{ position:absolute; z-index:2; left:50%; bottom:calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); translate:-50% 0; width:1px; height:52px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); opacity:0; animation:fadeUp 1.1s var(--out) 2.5s forwards; }
.scroll-cue::after{ content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:-40%; width:1px; height:40%; background:linear-gradient(transparent, #fff); animation:drip 2.2s var(--inout) infinite; }
@keyframes drip{ to{ top:100%; } }

/* ================= TEXT REVEALS ================= */
.sec-title{ font-size:clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.8rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.045em; line-height:1.03; margin:0 0 .3em; }
.lede{ font-size:clamp(1.1rem, 1.8vw, 1.32rem); color:var(--muted); max-width:46ch; margin:0; line-height:1.45; letter-spacing:-.02em; }
.split .w{ display:inline-block; overflow:hidden; vertical-align:top; padding-bottom:.12em; margin-bottom:-.12em; }
.split .w > span{ display:inline-block; }
[data-split] .w > span{ transform:translateY(106%); transition:transform 1.3s var(--out); transition-delay:calc(var(--i) * 55ms); }
[data-split].in .w > span{ transform:none; }
.reveal{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(34px); transition:opacity 1.2s var(--out), transform 1.2s var(--out); transition-delay:var(--d, 0s); }
.reveal.in{ opacity:1; transform:none; }

/* ================= FEATURED (stacking cards) ================= */
#maps{ padding-top:clamp(56px, 8vw, 110px); }
.stack{ margin-top:56px; }
.fcard{
  --c:var(--blue); --dim:0;
  position:sticky; top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 80px + var(--i) * 16px);
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1.2fr; align-items:center; gap:clamp(28px, 4vw, 56px);
  padding:clamp(24px, 3.2vw, 40px); margin-bottom:64px; border-radius:32px;
  min-height:min(560px, calc(100vh - 150px));
  background:#101012;
  background:radial-gradient(100% 80% at 100% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 20%, transparent), transparent 58%), linear-gradient(165deg, #19191c 0%, #0b0b0c 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07), 0 -40px 90px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.95);
  transform-origin:50% 0; will-change:transform; overflow:hidden;
}
.fcard::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; background:#000; opacity:var(--dim); pointer-events:none; will-change:opacity; }
.fcard:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }
.f-text{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0; }
.f-meta{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px 14px; font-size:.88rem; color:var(--muted); }
.genre{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--text); font-weight:500; }
.genre::before{ content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c); }
.badge-new{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(48,209,88,.14); color:var(--green); font-weight:600; font-size:.78rem; }
.badge-new::before{ content:""; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); animation:ping 2s var(--out) infinite; }
.f-title{ font-size:clamp(2.4rem, 4.2vw, 3.6rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.05em; line-height:1; margin:18px 0 6px; }
.f-alt{ color:var(--muted); font-size:1rem; }
.f-desc{ color:var(--soft); font-size:1.04rem; line-height:1.55; margin:14px 0 26px; max-width:44ch; }
.f-stats{ display:flex; margin-bottom:24px; }
.f-stats div{ padding:0 22px; border-left:1px solid var(--line); }
.f-stats div:first-child{ padding-left:0; border-left:0; }
.f-stats b{ display:block; font-size:clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 1.95rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.04em; line-height:1.1; }
.f-stats span{ display:block; margin-top:3px; font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.3; color:var(--muted); }
.chips{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px; margin-bottom:28px; }
.chip{ padding:5px 12px; border-radius:980px; font-size:.8rem; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); color:var(--soft); }
.f-actions{ margin-top:auto; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.f-media{ position:relative; min-width:0; }
.f-media::before{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:14% 6% -14% 6%; background:radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 42%, transparent), transparent); pointer-events:none; }
.f-art{
  position:relative; z-index:1; display:block; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden;
  background:#060607; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  clip-path:inset(7% 7% 7% 7% round 22px);
  transition:clip-path 1.6s var(--out), transform .8s var(--out);
}
.fcard.in .f-art{ clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0 round 22px); }
.f-art.is-art{ display:grid; place-items:center; background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 58%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 26%, transparent), transparent 66%), #060607; }
.f-art svg{ width:100%; height:100%; }
.f-art img{ position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transform-origin:50% 50%; animation:kenburns 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes kenburns{ from{ transform:scale(1); } to{ transform:scale(1.05); } }
.f-play{ position:absolute; inset:0; display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,0); transition:background .6s var(--out); }
.f-play span{ width:74px; height:74px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; color:#fff; background:rgba(255,255,255,.16); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px); opacity:0; transform:scale(.75); transition:opacity .5s var(--out), transform .7s var(--out); }
.f-play svg{ width:26px; height:26px; margin-left:4px; }
.f-art:hover .f-play{ background:rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
.f-art:hover .f-play span{ opacity:1; transform:none; }
.f-art .float{ transform-box:fill-box; animation:bob2 4.4s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay:var(--d); }
@keyframes bob2{ 50%{ transform:translateY(-8px); } }
.f-art .dash{ animation:dash 1.4s linear infinite; }
@keyframes dash{ to{ stroke-dashoffset:-22; } }
.f-art .belt{ animation:belt 1s linear infinite; }
@keyframes belt{ to{ stroke-dashoffset:-24; } }
.f-art .wobble{ transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:50% 100%; animation:wobble 3s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay:var(--d); }
@keyframes wobble{ 0%,55%,100%{ transform:rotate(0); } 63%{ transform:rotate(-7deg); } 73%{ transform:rotate(6deg); } 83%{ transform:rotate(-3deg); } 91%{ transform:rotate(1.5deg); } }
.f-art .coin{ transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; opacity:0; animation:coin 3.4s var(--out) infinite; animation-delay:var(--d); }
@keyframes coin{ 0%{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(24px) scale(.5); } 18%{ opacity:1; } 100%{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(-80px) scale(1); } }
.f-art .rise{ transform-box:fill-box; animation:rise 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay:var(--d); }
@keyframes rise{ 0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0); opacity:.55; } 50%{ transform:translateY(-6px); opacity:1; } }
.f-art .flag{ transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:0 50%; animation:flag 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes flag{ to{ transform:scaleX(.8) skewY(7deg); } }
.f-art .glow{ animation:glow 3.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes glow{ from{ opacity:.5; } to{ opacity:1; } }

/* ================= ABOUT ================= */
#about{ padding:0; }
.scrub-wrap{ position:relative; height:220vh; }
.scrub-sticky{ position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.scrub{ font-size:clamp(1.9rem, 4.6vw, 3.7rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.045em; line-height:1.13; margin:0; max-width:24ch; }
.scrub .sw{ color:var(--dim); transition:color .5s var(--out); }
.scrub .sw.lit{ color:var(--text); }
.stats-panel{ position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr); border-radius:28px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); border:1px solid var(--line); overflow:hidden; }
.stats-panel::before{ content:""; position:absolute; top:0; left:12%; right:12%; height:1px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.35), transparent); }
.stat{ padding:clamp(24px, 3vw, 38px); border-left:1px solid var(--line); }
.stat:first-child{ border-left:0; }
.stat b{ display:block; font-size:clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.2rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.055em; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 40%, #8E8E93); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; }
.stat span{ display:block; margin-top:10px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.92rem; }
.stats-note{ margin:14px 4px 0; color:#636366; font-size:.8rem; }

/* ================= SKILLS ================= */
.skills-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:14px; margin-top:52px; }
.skill{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:30px 28px 32px; border-radius:24px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border:1px solid var(--line); transition:transform .6s var(--out), border-color .5s var(--out), background .5s var(--out); }
.skill:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:var(--line-2); background:rgba(255,255,255,.055); }
.spotlight::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:0; transition:opacity .5s var(--out); background:radial-gradient(340px circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 50%), rgba(255,255,255,.08), transparent 62%); }
.spotlight:hover::after{ opacity:1; }
.s-ic{ width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:14px; display:grid; place-items:center; margin-bottom:22px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 16%, transparent); color:var(--c); }
.s-ic svg{ width:22px; height:22px; }
.skill h3{ margin:0 0 8px; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.03em; }
.skill p{ margin:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:.96rem; }

.verse-head{ margin-top:clamp(100px, 12vw, 150px); }
.verse-head h3{ font-size:clamp(2rem, 4.2vw, 3.2rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.045em; line-height:1.05; margin:0 0 .3em; }
.story{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr; gap:clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px); margin-top:40px; }
.story-pin{ position:sticky; top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 100px); align-self:start; }
.code-win{ position:relative; border-radius:22px; background:#141416; border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:0 40px 100px -40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c, #0A84FF) 55%, transparent); transition:box-shadow 1s var(--out); }
.glow-border::before{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; padding:1px; pointer-events:none; opacity:.8;
  background:conic-gradient(from var(--ang), transparent 0 65%, var(--c, var(--blue)) 80%, transparent 95%);
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite:xor;
  mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  animation:spin 8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin{ to{ --ang:360deg; } }
.code-bar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.code-bar i{ width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; }
.code-bar i:nth-child(1){ background:#FF5F57; } .code-bar i:nth-child(2){ background:#FEBC2E; } .code-bar i:nth-child(3){ background:#28C840; }
.code-bar span{ margin-left:10px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); transition:opacity .3s; }
.code-body{ position:relative; min-height:490px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:0 0 22px 22px; }
.code-win .code-body pre{ background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:0; }
.code-body pre{ --gw:2em; --pv:20px; --ph:18px; position:absolute; inset:0; margin:0; padding:var(--pv) var(--ph); overflow:auto; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:.79rem; line-height:1.75; color:#D6D6DA; counter-reset:ln; pointer-events:none; }
.code-body pre.wide{ --gw:3.1em; }
.code-body pre.on{ pointer-events:auto; }
.code-body .ln{ display:block; white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; padding-left:calc(var(--gw) + 1.4em); text-indent:calc(-1 * (var(--gw) + 1.4em)); opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px); transition:opacity .35s var(--out), transform .5s var(--out); }
.code-body pre.on .ln{ opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:calc(var(--i) * 28ms); }
.code-body .ln::before{ counter-increment:ln; content:counter(ln); display:inline-block; width:var(--gw); margin-right:1.4em; text-indent:0; text-align:right; color:#48484A; }
.code-hd{ display:flex; gap:1.4em; margin:calc(-1 * var(--pv)) calc(-1 * var(--ph)) 12px; padding:9px var(--ph); white-space:pre; overflow:hidden; background:#1B1B1E; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); box-shadow:0 10px 18px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.95); opacity:0; transition:opacity .4s var(--out); }
.code-hd .n{ flex:none; width:var(--gw); text-align:right; color:#636366; }
.code-body pre.on .code-hd{ opacity:1; }
.caret{ display:inline-block; width:7px; height:1.05em; vertical-align:-3px; background:var(--sky); animation:blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes blink{ 50%{ opacity:0; } }
.tk-c{ color:#6C7986; font-style:italic; } .tk-s{ color:#FC6A5D; } .tk-k{ color:#FF7AB2; font-weight:500; }
.tk-t{ color:#5DD8FF; } .tk-n{ color:#D0BF69; } .tk-a{ color:#BF8AF2; }
.story-steps{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.step{ min-height:78vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; opacity:.2; transition:opacity .8s var(--out); }
.step.on{ opacity:1; }
.step small{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--c); font-weight:600; font-size:.92rem; }
.step small::before{ content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c); }
.step h4{ font-size:clamp(2rem, 3.8vw, 2.9rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.045em; line-height:1.05; margin:.25em 0 .4em; }
.step p{ margin:0; color:var(--soft); max-width:42ch; font-size:1.06rem; }

/* ================= ISLANDS ================= */
.marquee{ overflow:hidden; margin-top:52px; -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent); }
.marquee + .marquee{ margin-top:12px; }
.track{ display:flex; width:max-content; animation:marquee 60s linear infinite; will-change:transform; }
.marquee.rev .track{ animation-direction:reverse; animation-duration:72s; }
@keyframes marquee{ to{ transform:translate3d(-50%, 0, 0); } }
.mq{ flex:none; margin-right:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:13px 22px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); border:1px solid var(--line); font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--soft); white-space:nowrap; }
.mq i{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); }
.tiles{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap:12px; margin-top:44px; }
.tile{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:22px; min-height:140px; padding:22px 20px 18px 22px; border-radius:22px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border:1px solid var(--line); transition:transform .6s var(--out), border-color .5s var(--out), background .5s var(--out); }
.tile:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:var(--line-2); background:rgba(255,255,255,.055); }
.tile h3{ margin:0; font-size:1.08rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1.25; }
.tile-foot{ margin-top:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.tile-foot code{ font-family:var(--mono); font-size:.84rem; color:var(--muted); margin-right:auto; transition:color .4s; }
.tile:hover .tile-foot code{ color:var(--soft); }

/* ================= CONTACT ================= */
.contact{ text-align:center; overflow:hidden; padding:clamp(120px, 16vw, 210px) 0; }
.contact .aurora{ inset:15% -10% -35% -10%; opacity:.75; }
.contact .wrap{ position:relative; z-index:2; }
.contact .sec-title{ font-size:clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6.4rem); max-width:13ch; margin-inline:auto; }
.contact .lede{ margin:0 auto; }
.contact-actions{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:10px; margin-top:40px; }
.contact-links{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:10px 28px; margin-top:26px; font-size:.95rem; }
footer{ padding:26px 0 34px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); color:#6E6E73; font-size:.8rem; }
footer .wrap{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; }

/* ================= WORK WITH ME SHEET ================= */
.modal{
  position:fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; max-width:none; max-height:none; margin:0; border:0;
  padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 20px) 16px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 20px);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0); color:var(--text); display:none; place-items:center; overflow:auto;
  transition:background .5s var(--out), backdrop-filter .5s var(--out), -webkit-backdrop-filter .5s var(--out);
}
.modal[open]{ display:grid; }
.modal::backdrop{ background:transparent; }
.modal.show{ background:rgba(0,0,0,.6); backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(140%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(140%); }
.modal-card{
  position:relative; width:min(440px, 100%); padding:42px 28px 28px; border-radius:32px; text-align:center; overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(170deg, #26262b 0%, #111113 100%);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08), 0 50px 120px -30px rgba(88,101,242,.55);
  opacity:0; transform:translateY(40px) scale(.94);
  transition:opacity .45s var(--out), transform .8s var(--out);
}
.modal.show .modal-card{ opacity:1; transform:none; }
.modal-card::before{ content:""; position:absolute; top:-45%; left:50%; width:440px; height:440px; margin-left:-220px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(88,101,242,.45), transparent 65%); pointer-events:none; animation:glowPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes glowPulse{ from{ opacity:.6; transform:scale(.92); } to{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1.08); } }
.modal-x{ position:absolute; top:14px; right:14px; z-index:2; }
.m-badge{ position:relative; width:66px; height:66px; margin:0 auto 20px; border-radius:21px; display:grid; place-items:center; background:var(--discord); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 14px 34px -10px rgba(88,101,242,.95); }
.m-badge svg{ width:30px; height:30px; }
.m-badge::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:-6px; border-radius:26px; border:2px solid rgba(88,101,242,.7); animation:ring 2.4s var(--out) infinite; }
@keyframes ring{ from{ transform:scale(.94); opacity:1; } to{ transform:scale(1.35); opacity:0; } }
.modal h2{ position:relative; margin:0 0 8px; font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.045em; line-height:1.1; }
.modal p{ position:relative; margin:0 auto 24px; color:var(--muted); max-width:30ch; }
.people{ position:relative; display:grid; gap:10px; margin-bottom:18px; text-align:left; }
.person{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:12px 12px 12px 14px; border-radius:20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); border:1px solid var(--line); transition:background .4s var(--out), border-color .4s var(--out); }
.person:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.09); border-color:var(--line-2); }
.avatar{ width:44px; height:44px; flex:none; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:700; font-size:1.1rem; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--a1), var(--a2)); }
.person-info{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
.person-info b{ display:block; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.person-info span{ font-size:.82rem; color:var(--muted); }
.modal .pill.discord{ width:100%; padding:15px 24px; font-size:1.02rem; }
.m-link{ position:relative; display:block; margin-top:12px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); }
.modal .stg{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px); transition:opacity .45s var(--out), transform .7s var(--out); }
.modal.show .stg{ opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:calc(.1s + var(--s) * 60ms); }

/* Toast */
.toast{ position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); z-index:120; translate:-50% 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 20px 12px 16px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(44,44,46,.9); backdrop-filter:blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); font-weight:500; font-size:.92rem; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .4s var(--out), translate .6s var(--out); }
.toast.show{ opacity:1; translate:-50% 0; }
.toast svg{ width:18px; height:18px; color:var(--green); }

/* ================= ROTATING HERO PILL ================= */
.rot{ position:relative; display:inline-block; height:1.4em; overflow:hidden; vertical-align:bottom; transition:width .7s var(--out); }
.rot span{ position:absolute; left:0; top:0; white-space:nowrap; opacity:0; transform:translateY(95%); transition:transform .8s var(--out), opacity .5s var(--out); }
.rot span.cur{ opacity:1; transform:none; }
.rot span.out{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(-95%); }
.sr{ position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0 0 0 0); white-space:nowrap; }

/* ================= PRICING ================= */
.value-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:14px; margin-top:52px; }
.value{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:32px 28px 34px; border-radius:26px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border:1px solid var(--line); transition:transform .6s var(--out), border-color .5s var(--out), background .5s var(--out); }
.value:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:var(--line-2); background:rgba(255,255,255,.055); }
.value.best{ background:radial-gradient(120% 100% at 0% 0%, rgba(48,209,88,.17), transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.04); border-color:rgba(48,209,88,.22); }
.v-ic{ width:46px; height:46px; border-radius:14px; display:grid; place-items:center; margin-bottom:24px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 16%, transparent); color:var(--c); }
.v-ic svg{ width:22px; height:22px; }
.value h3{ margin:0 0 8px; font-size:1.45rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.035em; line-height:1.15; }
.value p{ margin:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:.98rem; }
.price-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:14px 22px; margin-top:34px; }
.price-row span{ color:var(--muted); font-size:.98rem; }
.price-chip{ position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin:2px 0 14px; padding:5px 12px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(48,209,88,.14); color:var(--green); font-size:.82rem; font-weight:600; }
.price-chip svg{ width:14px; height:14px; }

/* ================= CLIENT WORK ================= */
.client-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.45fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-top:52px; align-items:stretch; }
.clip{
  position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:28px; overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer;
  background:#060607; border:1px solid var(--line);
  clip-path:inset(6% 6% 6% 6% round 28px); transition:clip-path 1.6s var(--out);
}
.clip.in{ clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0 round 28px); }
.clip video, .clip .clip-media{ position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
.clip::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0 0; height:40%; background:linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.55)); pointer-events:none; }
.clip-label{ position:absolute; z-index:2; left:16px; bottom:16px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:8px 15px 8px 12px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.5); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:500; }
.clip-label svg{ width:15px; height:15px; color:var(--yellow); }
.clip-state{ position:absolute; z-index:2; right:16px; top:16px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 11px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.5); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px); font-size:.76rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--soft); transition:opacity .4s var(--out); }
.clip-state i{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--yellow); animation:ping 2s var(--out) infinite; }
.clip.paused .clip-state i{ animation:none; background:var(--muted); }
.client-stats{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; }
.cstat{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end; padding:24px 22px; border-radius:24px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); border:1px solid var(--line); }
.cstat.hl{ background:radial-gradient(120% 100% at 0% 0%, rgba(255,214,10,.16), transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.04); border-color:rgba(255,214,10,.22); }
.cstat b{ display:block; font-size:clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.7rem); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.05em; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; background:linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 40%, #8E8E93); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; }
.cstat span{ display:block; margin-top:8px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.88rem; line-height:1.3; }
.proof{ margin-top:14px; padding:12px; border-radius:22px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); border:1px solid var(--line); overflow-x:auto; }
.proof img{ width:100%; min-width:760px; border-radius:12px; }
.proof-cap{ margin:12px 4px 0; color:#636366; font-size:.8rem; }

/* ================= RESPONSIVE ================= */
@media (max-width: 1099px){ .floaty{ display:none; } }
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .fcard{ position:relative; top:auto; grid-template-columns:1fr; min-height:0; margin-bottom:20px; }
  .fcard::after{ display:none; }
  .f-media{ order:-1; }
  .stats-panel{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }
  .stat:nth-child(3){ border-left:0; }
  .stat:nth-child(n+3){ border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  .skills-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }
  .value-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .client-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .story{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .story-pin{ top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 56px); z-index:3; background:#000; margin-inline:-20px; padding:10px 20px 14px; }
  .code-body{ min-height:0; height:36vh; }
  .code-body pre{ font-size:.68rem; --pv:14px; --ph:12px; }
  .step{ min-height:60vh; }
  .scrub-wrap{ height:180vh; }
}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .hide-sm{ display:none; }
  .nav-in{ gap:12px; }
  .skills-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .f-stats div{ padding:0 14px; }
  .f-actions .pill.primary{ flex:1 1 100%; }
  .f-actions .code-btn{ flex:1 1 auto; }
  .modal-card{ padding:40px 20px 22px; border-radius:28px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{ animation-duration:.01ms !important; animation-delay:0s !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:.01ms !important; transition-delay:0s !important; }
  .loader{ display:none; }
  .f-art, .clip{ clip-path:none !important; }
  .reveal, [data-split] .w > span, .hero-sub .w > span, .hero-title .ch{ opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important; filter:none !important; }
  html{ scroll-behavior:auto; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="loader" id="loader" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="loader-in"><div class="loader-name">hrkurdish</div><div class="loader-bar"><span></span></div></div>
</div>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav class="nav" id="nav" aria-label="Main">
  <div class="wrap nav-in">
    <a class="brand" href="#top"><i></i>hrkurdish</a>
    <div class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
      <span class="nav-ind" id="navInd" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <a href="#maps">Maps</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#about">About</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#skills">Skills</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#islands">Islands</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#client">Clients</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </div>
    <a class="pill primary sm magnetic" href="#contact" data-open="work" aria-haspopup="dialog">Work with me</a>
  </div>
  <div class="progress" id="progress"></div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<header class="hero" id="top">
  <div class="aurora" id="aurora" aria-hidden="true"><span class="blob b1"></span><span class="blob b2"></span><span class="blob b3"></span></div>

  <div class="floaty" data-depth="36" style="--i:0;--c:var(--sky);left:10%;top:28%"><span><i></i>Verse</span></div>
  <div class="floaty" data-depth="24" style="--i:1;--c:var(--purple);right:11%;top:24%"><span><i></i>UEFN</span></div>
  <div class="floaty" data-depth="48" style="--i:2;--c:var(--orange);left:14%;bottom:27%"><span><i></i>Parkour</span></div>
  <div class="floaty" data-depth="30" style="--i:3;--c:var(--yellow);right:14%;bottom:29%"><span><i></i>Tycoon</span></div>

  <div class="hero-content" id="heroContent">
    <div class="hero-pill"><span class="live"></span><span class="rot" id="heroRot" aria-hidden="true"><span>Over 10 Fortnite maps made</span><span>Lower prices than other creators</span><span>20,000+ lines of Verse in one map</span><span>Our Skip Level sold 2,797 times</span></span><span class="sr">Over 10 Fortnite maps made. Lower prices than other creators. 20,000+ lines of Verse in one map. Our Skip Level sold 2,797 times.</span></div>
    <h1 class="hero-title" id="heroTitle">hrkurdish</h1>
    <p class="hero-sub split" id="heroSub">I build Fortnite islands in UEFN and bring them to life with Verse.</p>
    <div class="hero-cta">
      <a class="pill primary magnetic" href="#maps">See my maps</a>
      <a class="pill glass magnetic" href="#contact" data-open="work" aria-haspopup="dialog">Work with me</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="scroll-cue" aria-hidden="true"></div>
</header>

<main id="site-main">
<!-- FEATURED MAPS -->
<section id="maps">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2 class="sec-title" data-split>Featured maps</h2>
    <p class="lede reveal">Three islands you can play right now. Copy a code or jump straight into Fortnite.</p>
    <div class="stack" id="stack"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">
  <div class="scrub-wrap" id="scrubWrap">
    <div class="scrub-sticky">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="scrub" id="scrub">I've made over 10 Fortnite maps, from 1v1s and zone wars to deathruns and tycoons. I build every island in UEFN and write the gameplay in Verse, so it plays exactly the way I picture it.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="wrap" style="padding-bottom:clamp(64px, 9vw, 110px)">

    StepPropTo(Prop : creative_prop, Position : vector3, Facing : rotation, Seconds : float)<suspends> : void =
        Duration := if (Seconds > MinMoveTime) then Seconds else MinMoveTime
        if (Prop.TeleportTo[Position, Facing]) {}

        Duration := if (Seconds > MinMoveTime) then Seconds else MinMoveTime
        race:
            MoveStep(Prop, Position, Facing, Duration)

using { /Verse.org/Simulation }

loadout_manager := class(creative_device):
    @editable LobbyTimer : timer_device = timer_device{}
    @editable ArenaSpawn : teleporter_device = teleporter_device{}
    @editable SlotGranters : []item_granter_device = array{}

    OnBegin<override>()<suspends> : void =
        LobbyTimer.SuccessEvent.Subscribe(OnLobbyDone)

    OnLobbyDone(MaybeAgent : ?agent) : void =
        for (Player : GetPlayspace().GetPlayers()):
            ArenaSpawn.Teleport(Player)
            # 5 slots: SMG, shotgun, AR, mobility, heal
            for (Granter : SlotGranters):

`using { /Fortnite.com/Devices }
using { /Verse.org/Simulation }

reboot_controller := class(creative_device):
    @editable RebootVans : []reboot_van_spawner_device = array{}
    @editable RebootsTimer : timer_device = timer_device{}
    @editable StopSwitch : switch_device = switch_device{}

    OnBegin<override>()<suspends> : void =
        RebootsTimer.SuccessEvent.Subscribe(OnTimerEnd)
        StopSwitch.TurnedOnEvent.Subscribe(OnStop)

    SetVans(On : logic) : void =
        for (Van : RebootVans):
            if (On?) then Van.Enable() else Van.Disable()

    OnTimerEnd(MaybeAgent : ?agent) : void = SetVans(false)
    OnStop(Agent : agent) : void = RebootsTimer.Pause(Agent)` }

/* ---------- self-repair: if a host (like a GitHub Pages theme) wraps this page in its own layout,
   move the site back out, drop the host's styles and restore full-screen layout ---------- */
(function rescueFromHostLayout(){
  const nav = document.getElementById("nav");
  if (!nav || nav.parentElement === document.body) return;
  const keep = ["loader", "nav", "top", "site-main", "site-footer", "work", "toast"]
    .map(id => document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean);
  const css = document.getElementById("site-css");
  if (css) document.head.appendChild(css);
  document.querySelectorAll('link[href*="fonts.googleapis.com"], link[href*="fonts.gstatic.com"]').forEach(l => document.head.appendChild(l));
  document.querySelectorAll('link[rel~="stylesheet"]').forEach(l => { if (!/fonts\.googleapis\.com/.test(l.href)) l.remove(); });
  document.querySelectorAll("style").forEach(st => { if (st.id !== "site-css") st.remove(); });
  if (!document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]')){
    const m = document.createElement("meta"); m.name = "viewport"; m.content = "width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"; document.head.appendChild(m);
  }
  const scripts = [...document.querySelectorAll("body script")];
  document.body.replaceChildren(...keep, ...scripts);
  document.body.removeAttribute("class");
  document.documentElement.removeAttribute("class");
  document.title = "hrkurdish | UEFN Creator and Verse Developer";
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
})();

/* ---------- loader ---------- */
(function(){
  const loader = $("#loader");
  if (reduced){ loader.remove(); return; }
  setTimeout(() => loader.remove(), 2200);
})();

/* ---------- smooth scrolling (falls back to native if the library can't load) ---------- */
let lenis = null;
if (!reduced && window.Lenis){
  try {
    lenis = new Lenis({ duration: 1.15, easing: t => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)), smoothWheel: true });
    (function raf(time){ lenis.raf(time); requestAnimationFrame(raf); })(performance.now());
  } catch (err){ lenis = null; }
}

/* ---------- text splitting ---------- */
function splitWords(el){
  const text = el.textContent.trim();
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", text);
  el.innerHTML = text.split(/\s+/).map((w, i) => `<span class="w" aria-hidden="true"><span style="--i:${i}">${esc(w)}</span></span>`).join(" ");
}
(function(){
  const h = $("#heroTitle"), txt = h.textContent.trim();
  h.setAttribute("aria-label", txt);
  h.innerHTML = [...txt].map((c, i) => `<span class="ch" aria-hidden="true" style="--i:${i}">${esc(c)}</span>`).join("");
  splitWords($("#heroSub"));
  $$("[data-split]").forEach(el => { el.classList.add("split"); splitWords(el); });
  const scrub = $("#scrub");
  scrub.innerHTML = scrub.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).map(w => `<span class="sw">${esc(w)}</span>`).join(" ");
})();

/* ---------- animated map art (original illustrations) ---------- */
const glowDef = (c, id) => `<radialGradient id="${id}r"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${c}" stop-opacity=".38"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${c}" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>`;
function artParkour(c, id){
  const plats = [[48, 236, 96], [168, 200, 84], [272, 164, 80], [180, 122, 76], [286, 82, 78]];
  const path = "M96 234 Q153 168 210 198 Q261 126 312 162 Q265 98 218 120 Q271 48 325 80";
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" aria-hidden="true">
    <defs><linearGradient id="${id}g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${c}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${c}" stop-opacity=".35"/></linearGradient>${glowDef(c, id)}</defs>
    <circle class="glow" cx="200" cy="160" r="150" fill="url(#${id}r)"/>
    <path class="dash" d="${path}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-opacity=".75" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-dasharray="2 9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    ${plats.map(([x, y, w], i) => `<g class="float" style="--d:${(i * -.7).toFixed(1)}s"><rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="14" rx="7" fill="url(#${id}g)"/><rect x="${x + 8}" y="${y + 15}" width="${w - 16}" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="${c}" opacity=".2"/></g>`).join("")}
    <g class="float" style="--d:-2.8s"><line x1="325" y1="82" x2="325" y2="38" stroke="#F5F5F7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path class="flag" d="M326 39 L354 48 L326 57 Z" fill="#F5F5F7"/></g>
    ${reduced ? "" : `<circle r="6" fill="#fff"><animateMotion dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keyPoints="0;1" keyTimes="0;1" keySplines=".45 0 .55 1" path="${path}"/></circle>`}
  </svg>`;
}
function artDuck(c, id){
  const eggs = [[110, "#8E8E93"], [200, c], [290, "#BF5AF2"]];
  const coins = [[118, 0], [206, 1.1], [286, 2.1], [160, 1.6], [248, .5]];
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" aria-hidden="true">
    <defs>${eggs.map(([, col], i) => `<radialGradient id="${id}e${i}" cx=".4" cy=".35" r=".8"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="${col}" stop-opacity=".9"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${col}" stop-opacity=".45"/></radialGradient>`).join("")}${glowDef(c, id)}</defs>
    <circle class="glow" cx="200" cy="170" r="150" fill="url(#${id}r)"/>
    <rect x="40" y="252" width="320" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1c1c1e" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.12)"/>
    <line class="belt" x1="54" y1="263" x2="346" y2="263" stroke="${c}" stroke-opacity=".6" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="12 12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    ${eggs.map(([x, col], i) => `<g class="wobble" style="--d:${(i * -.9).toFixed(1)}s"><ellipse cx="${x}" cy="206" rx="34" ry="44" fill="url(#${id}e${i})" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="${x - 10}" cy="196" r="5" fill="#fff" opacity=".5"/><circle cx="${x + 11}" cy="218" r="3.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".35"/></g>`).join("")}
    ${coins.map(([x, d]) => `<g class="coin" style="--d:${d}s"><circle cx="${x}" cy="150" r="9" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="150" r="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#7a5b00" stroke-width="1.6"/></g>`).join("")}
    <g class="float" style="--d:-1s">
      <ellipse cx="300" cy="84" rx="34" ry="22" fill="${c}"/>
      <circle cx="327" cy="60" r="15" fill="${c}"/>
      <path d="M340 58 L356 62 L340 67 Z" fill="#FF9F0A"/>
      <circle cx="331" cy="56" r="2.6" fill="#000"/>
      <path d="M284 80 q14 -12 26 2" fill="none" stroke="#b38f00" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </svg>`;
}
function artSpiral(c, id){
  let plats = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++){
    const t = i / 19, ang = i * .95, r = 132 * (1 - t * .55);
    const x = 200 + Math.cos(ang) * r, y = 262 - t * 210 + Math.sin(ang) * r * .16, w = 36 - t * 12;
    const cp = (i + 1) % 5 === 0;
    plats += `<g class="rise" style="--d:${(i * .09).toFixed(2)}s"><rect x="${(x - w / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${w.toFixed(1)}" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="${cp ? "#30D158" : c}" opacity="${(.5 + t * .5).toFixed(2)}"/></g>`;
  }
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" aria-hidden="true">
    <defs>${glowDef(c, id)}</defs>
    <circle class="glow" cx="200" cy="160" r="150" fill="url(#${id}r)"/>
    <text x="200" y="215" text-anchor="middle" font-family="-apple-system, Geist, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="190" letter-spacing="-12" fill="${c}" opacity=".08">20</text>
    ${plats}
  </svg>`;
}
const ART = { parkour: artParkour, duck: artDuck, spiral: artSpiral };

/* ---------- build: featured ---------- */
$("#stack").innerHTML = FEATURED.map((m, i) => `
  <article class="fcard" id="map-${m.id}" style="--i:${i};--c:${m.color}">
    <div class="f-text">
      <div class="f-meta"><span class="genre">${esc(m.genre)}</span><span>by ${esc(m.creator)}</span>${m.isNew ? '<span class="badge-new">New</span>' : ""}</div>
      <h3 class="f-title">${esc(m.name)}</h3>
      ${m.alt ? `<div class="f-alt" dir="auto">${esc(m.alt)}</div>` : ""}
      <p class="f-desc">${esc(m.desc)}</p>
      <div class="f-stats">${m.stats.map(([v, l]) => `<div><b>${esc(v)}</b><span>${esc(l)}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>
      <div class="chips">${m.chips.map(c => `<span class="chip">${esc(c)}</span>`).join("")}</div>
      <div class="f-actions">
        <a class="pill primary magnetic" href="https://www.fortnite.com/creative/island-codes/${m.code}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${ICONS.play}Play in Fortnite</a>
        <button class="pill glass code-btn" type="button" data-copy="${m.code}" data-toast="Island code copied" aria-label="Copy island code ${m.code}"><span class="mono">${m.code}</span>${ICONS.copy}${ICONS.check}</button>
        ${m.video ? `<a class="pill glass" href="${esc(m.video)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch trailer</a>` : ""}
        <a class="icon-btn lg" href="https://fortnite.gg/island/${m.code}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Stats on Fortnite.GG" aria-label="${esc(m.name)} stats on Fortnite.GG">${ICONS.chart}</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="f-media">
      <a class="f-art${m.image ? "" : " is-art"}" href="https://www.fortnite.com/creative/island-codes/${m.code}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Play ${esc(m.name)} in Fortnite">
        ${m.image ? `<img src="${m.image}" alt="" decoding="async"><span class="f-play" aria-hidden="true"><span>${ICONS.play}</span></span>` : ART[m.art](m.hex, m.id)}
      </a>
    </div>
  </article>`).join("");

/* ---------- build: skills ---------- */
$("#valueGrid").innerHTML = VALUES.map((v, i) => `
  <div class="value spotlight reveal${v.best ? " best glow-border" : ""}" style="--c:${v.c};--d:${i * .08}s">
    <div class="v-ic">${ICONS[v.i]}</div><h3>${esc(v.t)}</h3><p>${esc(v.d)}</p>
  </div>`).join("");

/* ---------- hero pill: rotating highlights ---------- */
(function(){
  const rot = $("#heroRot"); if (!rot) return;
  const items = [...rot.children]; let i = 0;
  const fit = () => { rot.style.width = items[i].offsetWidth + "px"; };
  items[0].classList.add("cur"); fit();
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fit);
  if (reduced || items.length < 2) return;
  setTimeout(() => setInterval(() => {
    const prev = items[i]; i = (i + 1) % items.length; const next = items[i];
    prev.classList.remove("cur"); prev.classList.add("out");
    next.classList.remove("out"); next.classList.add("cur");
    fit();
    setTimeout(() => prev.classList.remove("out"), 850);
  }, 3200), 1400);
})();

$("#skillsGrid").innerHTML = SKILLS.map((s, i) => `
  <div class="skill spotlight reveal" style="--c:${s.c};--d:${(i % 3) * .08}s">
    <div class="s-ic">${ICONS[s.i]}</div><h3>${esc(s.t)}</h3><p>${esc(s.d)}</p>
  </div>`).join("");

/* ---------- build: Verse story ---------- */
function highlight(line){
  const re = /(#[^\n]*)|("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")|(@\w+|<(?:override|suspends|decides|transacts)>)|\b(\d[\d_]*)\b|\b(using|class|if|then|else|for|set|var|or|and|not|return|false|true|race|sync|rush|branch|spawn|loop|block|break)\b|\b(void|int|logic|agent|player|float|string|map|array|color|vector3|rotation|creative_prop)\b/g;
  let out = "", last = 0, m;
  while ((m = re.exec(line))){
    out += esc(line.slice(last, m.index));
    const cls = m[1] ? "c" : m[2] ? "s" : m[3] ? "a" : m[4] ? "n" : m[5] ? "k" : "t";
    out += `<span class="tk-${cls}">${esc(m[0])}</span>`;
    last = re.lastIndex;
  }
  return out + esc(line.slice(last));
}
$("#codeBody").innerHTML = STORY.map((s, si) => {
  const lines = s.code.split("\n"), start = s.start || 1;
  const wide = String(start + lines.length).length > 3;
  const hd = s.header ? `<span class="code-hd"><span class="n">${s.header.n}</span><span>${highlight(s.header.text)}</span></span>` : "";
  return `<pre class="${si === 0 ? "on" : ""}${wide ? " wide" : ""}" style="counter-reset:ln ${start - 1}" aria-label="${esc(s.file)}"><code>${hd}${lines.map((l, i) => `<span class="ln" style="--i:${i}">${highlight(l) || " "}${i === lines.length - 1 ? '<span class="caret"></span>' : ""}</span>`).join("")}</code></pre>`;
}).join("");
$("#steps").innerHTML = STORY.map((s, i) => `
  <div class="step ${i === 0 ? "on" : ""}" data-i="${i}" style="--c:${s.color}">
    <small>${esc(s.kicker)}</small><h4>${esc(s.title)}</h4><p>${esc(s.text)}</p>
  </div>`).join("");
$("#codeWin").style.setProperty("--c", STORY[0].color);
$("#codeFile").textContent = STORY[0].file;

/* ---------- build: islands ---------- */
const ACCENTS = ["var(--sky)", "var(--purple)", "var(--orange)", "var(--yellow)", "var(--green)", "var(--blue)"];
const allNames = [...FEATURED.map(f => f.name), ...ISLANDS.map(x => x[0])];
function fillMarquee(el, names, offset){
  const items = names.map((n, i) => `<span class="mq" style="--c:${ACCENTS[(i + offset) % ACCENTS.length]}"><i></i>${esc(n)}</span>`).join("");
  el.querySelector(".track").innerHTML = items + items;
}
const half = Math.ceil(allNames.length / 2);
fillMarquee($("#mq1"), allNames.slice(0, half), 0);
fillMarquee($("#mq2"), allNames.slice(half), 3);
$("#tiles").innerHTML = ISLANDS.map(([n, code], i) => `
  <div class="tile spotlight reveal" style="--d:${(i % 4) * .06}s">
    <h3>${esc(n)}</h3>
    <div class="tile-foot">
      <code>${code}</code>
      <button class="icon-btn code-btn" type="button" data-copy="${code}" data-toast="Island code copied" aria-label="Copy code for ${esc(n)}">${ICONS.copy}${ICONS.check}</button>
      <a class="icon-btn" href="https://fortnite.gg/island/${code}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="${esc(n)} on Fortnite.GG">${ICONS.out}</a>
    </div>
  </div>`).join("");

/* ---------- build: contact + Discord sheet ---------- */
$("#contactActions").innerHTML =
  `<a class="pill discord magnetic" href="${esc(DISCORD.server)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${ICONS.chat}Join our Discord server</a>` +
  DISCORD.people.map(p => `<button class="pill glass code-btn magnetic" type="button" data-copy="${esc(p.user)}" data-toast="Discord username copied" aria-label="Copy Discord username ${esc(p.user)}"><span class="mono">${esc(p.user)}</span>${ICONS.copy}${ICONS.check}</button>`).join("");
$("#contactLinks").innerHTML = LINKS.map(([l, h]) => `<a class="tlink" href="${esc(h)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(l)}</a>`).join("");
$("#people").innerHTML = DISCORD.people.map((p, i) => `
  <div class="person stg" style="--s:${4 + i}">
    <div class="avatar" style="--a1:${p.a1};--a2:${p.a2}" aria-hidden="true">${esc(p.user.charAt(0).toUpperCase())}</div>
    <div class="person-info"><b>${esc(p.user)}</b><span>${esc(p.role)} on Discord</span></div>
    <button class="icon-btn code-btn" type="button" data-copy="${esc(p.user)}" data-toast="Discord username copied" aria-label="Copy Discord username ${esc(p.user)}">${ICONS.copy}${ICONS.check}</button>
  </div>`).join("");
$("#serverLink").href = DISCORD.server;
$("#serverText").textContent = DISCORD.server.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "");

/* ---------- sheet open / close ---------- */
let modalReturn = null;
function openModal(d){
  if (!d || d.open) return;
  modalReturn = document.activeElement;
  d.showModal();
  if (lenis) lenis.stop();
  document.documentElement.style.overflow = "hidden";
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => d.classList.add("show")));
}
function closeModal(d){
  if (!d || !d.open || d.dataset.closing) return;
  d.dataset.closing = "1";
  d.classList.remove("show");
  setTimeout(() => { d.close(); delete d.dataset.closing; }, reduced ? 0 : 450);
}
$$("dialog.modal").forEach(d => {
  d.addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target === d) closeModal(d); });
  d.addEventListener("cancel", e => { e.preventDefault(); closeModal(d); });
  d.addEventListener("close", () => {
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = "";
    if (lenis) lenis.start();
    if (modalReturn && modalReturn.focus) modalReturn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });
});

/* ---------- clicks: sheet, anchors, copy ---------- */
function toast(msg){
  const t = $("#toast"), host = document.querySelector("dialog[open]") || document.body;
  if (t.parentElement !== host){ t.classList.remove("show"); host.appendChild(t); void t.offsetWidth; }
  t.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12 5 5 9-10"/></svg>${esc(msg)}`;
  t.classList.add("show"); clearTimeout(toast.t); toast.t = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove("show"), 1900);
}
async function copyText(text){
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); return true; }
  catch {
    const ta = document.createElement("textarea"); ta.value = text; ta.style.cssText = "position:fixed;opacity:0"; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    let ok = false; try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch {} ta.remove(); return ok;
  }
}
document.addEventListener("click", async e => {
  const opener = e.target.closest("[data-open]");
  if (opener){ e.preventDefault(); openModal(document.getElementById(opener.dataset.open)); return; }
  if (e.target.closest("[data-close]")){ closeModal(e.target.closest("dialog")); return; }
  const anchor = e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
  if (anchor && lenis){
    const id = anchor.getAttribute("href");
    const target = id === "#top" ? 0 : document.querySelector(id);
    if (target !== null){ e.preventDefault(); lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: id === "#top" ? 0 : -56, duration: 1.5 }); history.replaceState(null, "", id); }
    return;
  }
  const b = e.target.closest("[data-copy]"); if (!b) return;
  const ok = await copyText(b.dataset.copy);
  if (ok){ toast(b.dataset.toast); b.classList.add("copied"); setTimeout(() => b.classList.remove("copied"), 1600); }
  else toast("Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.");
});

/* ---------- reveals + counters ---------- */
const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(en => {
  if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
  en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target);
  en.target.querySelectorAll("[data-count]").forEach(countUp);
}), { threshold: .15, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px" });
$$(".reveal, [data-split], .fcard, .clip").forEach(el => io.observe(el));
function countUp(el){
  const end = parseFloat(el.dataset.count), dec = +(el.dataset.decimals || 0), suf = el.dataset.suffix || "";
  const fmt = v => (el.dataset.sep ? Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US") : v.toFixed(dec)) + suf;
  if (reduced){ el.textContent = fmt(end); return; }
  const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 2000;
  (function tick(t){ const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / dur); el.textContent = fmt(end * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4))); if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); })(t0);
}

/* ---------- Verse story ---------- */
const steps = $$(".step"), pres = $$("#codeBody pre"), codeFile = $("#codeFile");
const stepIO = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(en => {
  if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
  const i = +en.target.dataset.i;
  steps.forEach((s, k) => s.classList.toggle("on", k === i));
  pres.forEach((p, k) => p.classList.toggle("on", k === i));
  codeFile.textContent = STORY[i].file;
  $("#codeWin").style.setProperty("--c", STORY[i].color);
}), { rootMargin: "-45% 0px -45% 0px" });
steps.forEach(s => stepIO.observe(s));

/* ---------- nav: active section pill ---------- */
const navLinks = $$("#navLinks a"), navInd = $("#navInd");
let activeLink = null;
function moveInd(){
  if (!activeLink || activeLink.offsetParent === null){ navInd.classList.remove("on"); return; }
  navInd.style.width = activeLink.offsetWidth + "px";
  navInd.style.transform = `translateX(${activeLink.offsetLeft}px)`;
  navInd.classList.add("on");
}
const secIO = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(en => {
  if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
  activeLink = navLinks.find(a => a.getAttribute("href") === "#" + en.target.id) || null;
  navLinks.forEach(a => a.classList.toggle("active", a === activeLink));
  moveInd();
}), { rootMargin: "-45% 0px -54% 0px" });
["top", "maps", "about", "skills", "islands", "client", "pricing", "contact"].forEach(id => secIO.observe(document.getElementById(id)));

/* ---------- Skip Level clip: looping video with safe fallbacks ---------- */
(function(){
  const M = window.SKIP_MEDIA || {}, clip = $("#skipClip"), state = $("#clipState");
  let v = $("#skipVideo"), stage = 0, usingImg = false, userPaused = false, visible = false;
  if (M.proof) $("#proofImg").src = M.proof;
  if (!v || !M.mp4){ return; }
  if (M.poster) v.poster = M.poster;
  function useImage(){
    if (usingImg || !M.webp) return;
    usingImg = true;
    const img = new Image(); img.src = M.webp; img.alt = ""; img.className = "clip-media"; img.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    v.replaceWith(img); v = null; state.innerHTML = "<i></i>Looping";
  }
  function tryBlob(){
    try {
      const bin = atob(M.mp4.split(",")[1]), bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      v.src = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: "video/mp4" }));
      v.load(); if (visible && !userPaused) play();
    } catch (err){ useImage(); }
  }
  function play(){
    if (!v) return;
    const p = v.play();
    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(err => { if (err && err.name === "NotAllowedError") useImage(); });
  }
  v.addEventListener("error", () => { stage++; if (stage === 1) tryBlob(); else useImage(); });
  v.src = M.mp4;
  // if nothing has loaded after a while, fall back to the animation
  setTimeout(() => { if (v && v.readyState < 2) useImage(); }, 6000);
  const vio = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => {
    visible = e.isIntersecting;
    if (!v) return;
    if (visible && !userPaused && !reduced) play(); else v.pause();
  }), { threshold: .25 });
  vio.observe(clip);
  function toggle(){
    if (!v) return;
    userPaused = !v.paused;
    if (userPaused){ v.pause(); } else { play(); }
    clip.classList.toggle("paused", userPaused);
    state.innerHTML = userPaused ? "<i></i>Paused" : "<i></i>Looping";
  }
  clip.addEventListener("click", toggle);
  clip.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " "){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); } });
  if (reduced){ userPaused = true; clip.classList.add("paused"); state.innerHTML = "<i></i>Paused"; }
})();

/* ---------- scroll-linked effects ---------- */
const nav = $("#nav"), prog = $("#progress"), heroC = $("#heroContent"), aurora = $("#aurora");
const fcards = $$(".fcard"), scrubWrap = $("#scrubWrap"), scrubWords = $$(".scrub .sw");
const wide = matchMedia("(min-width: 901px)");
let lastScrolled = null, lastLit = -1;
function frame(){
  const y = window.scrollY, vh = innerHeight, max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - vh;
  prog.style.transform = `scaleX(${max > 0 ? (y / max).toFixed(4) : 0})`;
  const sc = y > 8;
  if (sc !== lastScrolled){ nav.classList.toggle("scrolled", sc); lastScrolled = sc; }
  if (!reduced){
    if (y < vh * 1.2){
      const p = Math.min(1, y / vh);
      heroC.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${(p * -80).toFixed(1)}px, 0) scale(${(1 - p * .1).toFixed(4)})`;
      heroC.style.opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - p * 1.35).toFixed(3);
      aurora.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${(p * 160).toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
    }
    if (wide.matches){
      for (let i = 0; i < fcards.length - 1; i++){
        const a = fcards[i], top = a.getBoundingClientRect().top, h = a.offsetHeight;
        const q = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (top + h - fcards[i + 1].getBoundingClientRect().top) / h));
        a.style.transform = q ? `scale(${(1 - q * .06).toFixed(4)})` : "";
        a.style.setProperty("--dim", (q * .55).toFixed(3));
      }
    }
  }
  const r = scrubWrap.getBoundingClientRect(), total = r.height - vh;
  const p2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (-r.top + vh * .2) / (total * .95 + vh * .2)));
  const n = Math.round(p2 * scrubWords.length);
  if (n !== lastLit){ for (let i = 0; i < scrubWords.length; i++) scrubWords[i].classList.toggle("lit", i < n); lastLit = n; }
}
if (lenis) lenis.on("scroll", frame);
else { let ticking = false; addEventListener("scroll", () => { if (!ticking){ ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(() => { frame(); ticking = false; }); } }, { passive: true }); }
addEventListener("resize", () => {
  if (!wide.matches) fcards.forEach(c => { c.style.transform = ""; c.style.setProperty("--dim", 0); });
  moveInd(); frame();
});
frame();

/* ---------- pointer effects ---------- */
if (finePointer && !reduced){
  const floaties = $$(".floaty");
  let mx = .5, my = .5, cx = .5, cy = .5, running = false;
  function drift(){
    cx += (mx - cx) * .07; cy += (my - cy) * .07;
    floaties.forEach(f => { const d = +f.dataset.depth || 20; f.style.translate = `${((.5 - cx) * d).toFixed(2)}px ${((.5 - cy) * d).toFixed(2)}px`; });
    if (Math.abs(mx - cx) + Math.abs(my - cy) > .0008) requestAnimationFrame(drift); else running = false;
  }
  addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    mx = e.clientX / innerWidth; my = e.clientY / innerHeight;
    if (!running && scrollY < innerHeight){ running = true; requestAnimationFrame(drift); }
  }, { passive: true });

  $$(".magnetic").forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
      const r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
      b.style.translate = `${((e.clientX - r.left - r.width / 2) * .22).toFixed(1)}px ${((e.clientY - r.top - r.height / 2) * .32).toFixed(1)}px`;
    });
    b.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { b.style.translate = ""; });
  });

  document.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    const el = e.target.closest(".spotlight"); if (!el) return;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    el.style.setProperty("--mx", `${e.clientX - r.left}px`); el.style.setProperty("--my", `${e.clientY - r.top}px`);
  }, { passive: true });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
